name: stepper
title: Stepper
description: A number between the two buttons that step it.
use: A small number a reader nudges more often than types: seats, a quantity, a font size. It is an input group around a native number input; min, max and step are written once, on the field, and the script makes the two buttons call stepDown() and stepUp().

instead.when: The number is typed once and rarely adjusted, such as a port or a price
The value is a position in a wide range, where the exact figure matters less
The choice is among a few named amounts

keyboard.action: Step the value by step and stop at min and max, as a number input does

platform.fallback: The field keeps the width of --stepper-min instead of following the digits typed

classes.name: stepper
classes.description: On an input-group: a well as wide as its figure, with a button at each end. A button disabled at its limit lies flat in the well

classes.name: stepper-field
classes.description: On the group's input-group-field, a native number input: centered tabular figures, no spin buttons

properties.name: --stepper-min
properties.description: The narrowest the figure's box gets

properties.name: --stepper-max
properties.description: The widest it grows with field-sizing
